title: NOVEL ALKYL- AND PHENYLTHIOMETHYLATION OF AROMATIC COMPOUNDS
abstract: Abstract                It has been found that the Mannich bases, of which methylene is linked to amine nitrogen and alkyl- or phenylmercapto-sulfur affect smoothly, in the presence of acid catalyst, alkyl- or phenylthiomethylation of a number of aromatic compounds, i.e. 2-naphthol, aniline, indole and their derivatives.
